title: Nature Podcast cites a lead for “ancient Amazon earthworks,” but the underlying archaeology paper isn’t provided
summary: Nature Podcast ran a segment on “ancient structures hidden beneath the Amazon’s canopy” and credited Pärssinen et al., but the page you can access here does not give the identifying details needed to check what the authors actually claimed about the Amazon earthworks.

Independent experts identified shortcomings in IPPC permit and litigation was pending as of May 2025 with suspension risk.

claims.text: European battery price dynamics (IEA 2025): lithium-ion pack prices fell 20% in 2024 (largest drop since 2017), but declines asymmetric — nearly 30% in China vs 10-15% in Europe/US — widening China-Europe price gap and increasing Chinese producers' competitive advantage; LFP packs ~30% cheaper than NMC, the chemistry dominant in Europe/US.

claims.text: Assertion that 'Additional low-cost supply from Debrecen, once ramped, will weigh on European cell prices, benefiting automakers but squeezing Western gigafactories (Northvolt, ACC, Verkor)' is inferred conditional scenario, not sourced causal finding: no European offtake pricing or Western gigafactory utilization/cost-curve evidence links Chinese <40% utilization in 2023 to European price impact in 2026+; Hungarian battery factory production fell significantly in 2024 per KSH, and Northvolt utilization remains far below nameplate, indicating demand and ramp execution will determine price effects.
